translations.text: And he is not there for them to see him and for him to know everything. And this man will be checking on those in the other synagogue and striving to speak God's word to them every day.
Especially on the Sabbaths, when they gather together, he himself will teach, along with these two men and those appointed there to safeguard what has been written for us.
And if he is able to check on those in the village from year to year, he and these two men, along with others who fear him, [?]
[?] what happens [?] strength [?] not [?] to go [?] this man's [?] lead [?] according to fasting [?] each at his appointed time.
Is he not a worldly brother rather than a spiritual one, worrying about his heart because of the pride that torments everyone who makes room for it within themselves?
For God's people at that time, Israel, were organized in this way, with leaders over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens, while holy Moses was their leader.
[?] over the [?] and over all the fathers [?] over all the [?] and over the whole people.
Likewise Joshua [?], and after him also [?] judges in this way, down to holy Samuel, and afterward the kings and those with them, each in order.

So if this does not please the arrogant man, let him remember that a time is coming when God and his Christ Jesus, who is above everyone and in whose hands heaven and earth and everything in them are like these insignificant things, will issue a command, and he will give it to the saints so that they may judge the whole world.
If [?] pleases him to [?] righteousness [?] out, this is [?] that is at the doorway. They will [?] beside one another every Sabbath.
